title: Ghazi ka Parcham
body:
shabbir ka matam hai ruk na sakega
abbas ka parcham hai jhuk na sakega
<<DIVIDER>>
sada uncha ghazi ka parcham rahega
isi ke to saaye may aalam rahega
<<DIVIDER>>
jahan ibne zehra ka parcham rahega
wahan ibne maryam ka sar kham rahega
sada uncha ghazi ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
hilaale aza ne nikal kar sada di
kamar may hamesha meri kham rahega
sada uncha ghazi ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye kaala ghilaaf aaj bhi keh raha hai
haram may hamesha moharram rahega
sada uncha ghazi ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
jise apni raahein badalna ho badle
julooson ka rasta to mohkam rahega
sada uncha ghazi ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
chale jao rubaahon se bole ghazi
bas is taraayi pe zaigham rahega
sada uncha ghazi ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
bada mohtabar aab e zam zam hai maana
magar ashk e majlis muqaddam rahega
sada uncha ghazi ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
yahan kooze bharti mashke sakina
sabeelon pe pani kahan kam rahega
sada uncha ghazi ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
sada chashme momin barasti rahegi
hamesha moharram ka mausam rahega
sada uncha ghazi ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
rahe na rahe saari dunya may koi
magar ibne zehra tera gham rahega
sada uncha ghazi ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha sheh ne akbar ka laasha utha kar
hamari kamar may sada kham rahega
sada uncha ghazi ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
ali dekh kar bole ghazi ko sajjad
tere haath may mera parcham rahega
sada uncha ghazi ka...
author: Mir Sajjad Mir
